create_ModelConfig: create a ModelConfig instance from a model path with dtype, quantization, and context length settings
build_ModelConfig_from_server_args: build a ModelConfig from ServerArgs with model path, revision, quantization, and multimodal flags
verify_quantization_model_config: verify the quantization method of a ModelConfig against supported methods and hardware capabilities
get_model_attention_heads: get the total and per-GPU KV attention heads from a ModelConfig with tensor parallelism support
derive_model_shapes: derive model shapes including head_dim, hidden_size, attention layers, and vocab_size from HuggingFace config
